heading: Cloud platforms for your migration
intro: We compare the fit with your existing systems, data requirements, team skills, and operating model.
descriptions: AWS migration services typically involve workload discovery, target account and network planning, and a suitable compute and database destination. We plan validation and operational ownership alongside the move.

Azure migration services typically include readiness assessment, subscription and identity planning, and application or database migration. We review dependencies on existing Microsoft systems before choosing a destination.
A move to Google Cloud starts with workload discovery and dependency assessment. We compare infrastructure and managed-service options, then plan the data transfer and acceptance checks.

heading: Cost tools across cloud platforms
intro: We use the billing and usage information available in your cloud environment to support an AWS cost optimization or Azure cost optimization review, or a Google Cloud cost review.
descriptions: AWS Cost Explorer and billing reports can help investigate spend and evaluate eligible commitments. We connect that information with workload usage and resource ownership before proposing changes.
Azure Cost Management supports cost analysis and budget alerts. We review costs alongside resource utilization, ownership, and the limits your applications need to operate within.
Cloud Billing reports and budgets help teams review spend and investigate changes. We relate those views to projects, workload owners, and resource decisions; budget alerts alone do not cap usage.
